channel.title: Wire — Releases
channel.description: Releases from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Twenty Years of jQuery: How a Little Library Rewired Web Development
item.description: jQuery, created by John Resig and released in 2006, is a JavaScript library that simplifies HTML manipulation, event handling, animation, and Ajax. It enabled easier web development by providing an accessible API across browsers. (2 sources: infoq, javascriptweekly)

item.title: OpenAI GPT-6 Astra is now generally available on Amazon Bedrock
item.description: Today, AWS announces the general availability of GPT-6 Astra from OpenAI on Amazon Bedrock. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Timestream for InfluxDB 3 now supports custom plugins
item.description: Amazon Timestream for InfluxDB now lets you run your own custom Python plugins on the managed versions of InfluxDB 3 Core and Enterprise editions. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon SageMaker Feature Store now supports individual feature updates to lower write latency
item.description: Amazon SageMaker Feature Store is a fully managed capability that makes it easy to compute, store, and retrieve features for training and deploying AI models. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS Transform is now available in AWS GovCloud (US-West)
item.description: AWS Transform is now available in the AWS GovCloud (US-West) Region, enabling government agencies and regulated organizations to plan and execute large-scale migrations to AWS. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon API Gateway now supports mutual TLS for backend integrations
item.description: You can now configure Amazon API Gateway REST APIs to present an AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) certificate to your backend during the TLS handshake, enabling mutual TLS (mTLS). (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon RDS for MariaDB now supports community MariaDB minor versions 10.6.28, 10.11.19, 11.4.13, 11.8.9, and 12.3.3
item.description: Starting today, Amazon Relational Database Service (Amazon RDS) for MariaDB now supports MariaDB minor versions 10.6.28, 10.11.19, 11.4.13, 11.8.9, and 12.3.3, the latest minors released by community MariaDB. (1 source: aws)

item.title: HashiCorp Packer 1.16 Adds Native SLSA Provenance Generation and Verification for Machine Images
item.description: HashiCorp has released Packer v1.16.0, adding native support for generating, signing, and verifying SLSA provenance attestations for every image the tool builds. (1 source: infoq)
